TVEC × CLIPPING
The same audience, a different bill.

Our two music contests were invoiced €3,638 in total, for 30,043,834 views. Paid at the clipping example rate ($1 per 1,000 views), the same audiences would have been billed $30,044.

TVEC contest
A budget settled upfront: the cashprize and the commission. Whatever views follow cost nothing more.
Pay-per-view clipping
A bill that grows with the audience: rate per 1,000 views × views ÷ 1,000, fees included.

Indicative benchmark, not a quote or promise: currencies, fees, view criteria and content differ. Clipping rates vary by campaign; no percentage saving is inferred. Past results do not guarantee future performance. Whop source, accessed September 14, 2026

ONE BRIEF.

FRESH PERSPECTIVES.
EDIT.
Content worth watching

Edits made by real editors to fit naturally into TikTok culture, rather than ads that interrupt the feed.

Hundreds of edits on your track

A single contest triggers a wave of videos: your music circulates on hundreds of TikTok accounts at once, right when you release.

You only pay the best

The cashprize only rewards the winning edits. Every other published video stays online: that’s free promo.

Turnkey and secure, in 24h

Structured brief, poster design, jury, anti-cheat view verification and secure card payments (Stripe): you provide your track and the cashprize, TVEC handles everything else. Your contest is live in under 24h.
